answer: The strongest single control I know for this is Endorsed airport fire officer record with airport authority confirmation, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. Cloning 679 keys multiplies the price 679-fold: 74690 POA locked, or 9506 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. The inlet sits in the mechanism itself, the haven sits in the price of faking it, and the tide sits in the record no template can forge. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
